title: SWITCH FRAMES W1 light: Cmd-1..9 workspace switch by real HID keys, filmed at the display rate
why: Lawrence 2026-11-02: changing workspaces must change frame perfect, even with a ton of stuff. Each switch: the target's complete frame in the next refresh, no old frame after it, no blank or half-drawn frame, current terminal content, the sidebar selection in the same frame. The VM judge (scripts/cmux-next/switch-frames/judge_switch.py) reads the movie.
